question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right midfielder, Bob is playing striker, Claire is playing cheerleader, Dave is playing fullback, Eve is playing center midfielder, Fred is playing benchwarmer, and Gertrude is playing goalkeeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Dave trade positions. Then, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Eve and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. Finally, Bob and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) right midfielder
(B) striker
(C) cheerleader
(D) fullback
(E) center midfielder
(F) benchwarmer
(G) goalkeeper
solution:
Each row lists positions in the order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (right midfielder, striker, cheerleader, fullback, center midfielder, benchwarmer, goalkeeper)
1. Dave and Gertrude swap: (right midfielder, striker, cheerleader, goalkeeper, center midfielder, benchwarmer, fullback)
2. Gertrude and Dave swap: (right midfielder, striker, cheerleader, fullback, center midfielder, benchwarmer, goalkeeper)
3. Dave and Gertrude swap: (right midfielder, striker, cheerleader, goalkeeper, center midfielder, benchwarmer, fullback)
4. Eve and Alice swap: (center midfielder, striker, cheerleader, goalkeeper, right midfielder, benchwarmer, fullback)
5. Bob and Gertrude swap: (center midfielder, fullback, cheerleader, goalkeeper, right midfielder, benchwarmer, striker)
6. Bob and Gertrude swap: (center midfielder, striker, cheerleader, goalkeeper, right midfielder, benchwarmer, fullback)
7. Bob and Alice swap: (striker, center midfielder, cheerleader, goalkeeper, right midfielder, benchwarmer, fullback)
Dave is playing goalkeeper, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
